blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu—With fewer than seven weeks left in the year, some ₱65.57 million in the 2026 budget for Cebu Province’s third district have not yet been disbursed. Rep. Karen Garcia disclosed that this amount comprises ₱12.108 million allocated for assistance to barangay frontliners and ₱53.468 million in educational aid for students. “For the past seven years, this assistance has always been released every October. Our frontliners and our students could count on it. Now November is almost over and there is still nothing.
